simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חַלָּמִישׁ (H2496) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חַלָּמִישׁ (challâmîysh) means flint First listed occurrence: Deut 8 15.

definitions.full: H2496. challamish חַלָּמִישׁ noun masculine flint ; — חַלָּמִישׁ Deut 8:15 3 t.; construct חַלְמִישׁ 32:13 ; — flint הַח ׳צוּר rock of flint = flinty rock, whence water flowed for Israel in desert 8:15 , and (no צור ) Psa 114:8 ; worked by miners Job 28:9 ; hyperb. oil out of ׳ח צוּר Deut 32:13 flint of rock = rocky flint (poetry); — in simile of firmness כַּחַלָּמִישׁ מָּנַי שַׂמְתִּי עַלכֵּֿן Isa 50:7 . חֹלוֺן חֵלֹן, see below I. and II. חוֺל .
definitions.rootNote: probably from 2492 (in the sense of hardness );
